name: Avenging the Fallen
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The filth that calls itself Wildhammer trains gryphon to slay troll. Horrible, I know, but worry not, justice will soon be meted out.

For now, I want you to focus on eradicating the elder gryphons of the region. They are known as Skylords.

Slay one and return to me with its plume.
narrative.objectives:
Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.

Markhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.
narrative.offerRewardText:
<Markhor examines the plume.>

I wonder how many of our hunters this beast devoured before you brought it to justice.
narrative.requestItemsText: The Razorbeak Skylord is a much rarer breed of gryphon: One responsible for mating and creating murderous offspring.
